definitions.full: H5579. senappir סְנַמִּיר noun [masculine] fin (Late Hebrew id. ; quadriliteral according to Sta § 243 ; Fl in Levy NHWB iii. 725 a compare Aramaic סִמְמּוֺרִין points, nails , and derive this from סַמֵּר verb nail , with infixed פ (Levy ChWB ii. 507 b )); — Lev 11:9-10 , 12 = Deut 14:9-10 ,.
